Title: Cofounder and Chief Marketing Officer
Job Description:
We have started a venture which is related to ( *on demand logistics provider* ) so, we are looking for some enthusiastic and creative co-founder

As a Co-Founder of our platform.

• You'll be responsible for outlining the company's vision, implementing strategies, and ensuring that the resources are aligned with the company's business needs.

• You will work with me and other co-founders of the company, acting as both a product and business expert, while making decisions that will impact both current and future operations of FastX.

• You'll develop marketing and business strategies to turn our vision into reality.

• Ready to invest their time and money in the business.

• Creative, strategic thinker with the ability to lead a team.

• Domain expertise in Product, Leadership, Marketing, Sales, Technical experts, Software engineer,


What You Get:

Join as a Co-Founder and enjoy the ride with us. • Co-founder's equity

• We promise a work environment that's both exciting and supportive.
